qualifier: heparan and chondroitin/dermatan chains, with skeletal dysplasia defects
name: Heparan and chondroitin/dermatan sulfate proteoglycan biosynthesis
rationale: All members concern synthesis of heparan, heparin, chondroitin or dermatan sulfate proteoglycans or their inherited skeletal defects (EXT1/2, SLC35D1, SLC26A2), distinguishing the theme from broad O/N-glycosylation, keratan sulfate, nucleotide-sugar transport and GAG degradation neighbours.

qualifier: proteolytic cleavage and intracellular domain transmission to the nucleus
name: Notch receptor proteolytic activation and intracellular domain release
rationale: Members cover proteolytic processing and activation of NOTCH1-4 (including constitutively active NOTCH1 mutants) up to nuclear delivery of the intracellular domain, whereas confusables centre on NICD-driven target transcription and its negative regulation.

core: Neural tube neuronal patterning and fate specification
qualifier: hindbrain and spinal cord
name: Hindbrain and spinal cord neuron fate specification
rationale: Members concern dorsoventral patterning and motor/interneuron specification in the spinal cord plus hindbrain/brainstem development and respiratory control, which separates the theme from floor plate/notochord and midbrain dopaminergic neighbours.

qualifier: negative feedback and inactivation
name: ERK inactivation and negative feedback of MAPK signaling
rationale: All three members concern switching off ERK/MAPK signalling by dephosphorylation and feedback (including mutant MAPKs escaping it), unlike neighbours about ERK5, JNK/p38, AP-1 or RAS/RSK activation.

qualifier: erythroid and megakaryocytic branch
name: Erythroid and megakaryocyte lineage differentiation
rationale: Members concern red cell and platelet/megakaryocyte development (erythroid maturation, enucleation, oxygen transport, RUNX1 megakaryocyte programmes, TAL1-GFI1B module), distinguishing it from myeloid progenitor, granulocyte and monocyte confusables.

qualifier: at endosome membranes
name: Phosphoinositide synthesis and turnover at endosome membranes
rationale: Members concern phosphorylation and dephosphorylation of phosphatidylinositol phosphates on early and late endosomes, whereas confusables cover Golgi/plasma-membrane PIPs, inositol phosphates or endosome-Golgi and lysosomal traffic.

qualifier: G protein-coupled and ligand-gated subtypes
name: Serotonin receptor signaling via G proteins and channels
rationale: All members describe signalling by 5-HT receptors through adenylate cyclase, phospholipase C or the cation channel, unlike neighbours on serotonin synthesis/transport, histamine or muscarinic receptors.

qualifier: neutrophil respiratory burst and degranulation
name: Neutrophil respiratory burst, degranulation and microbial killing
rationale: Members concern neutrophil/monocyte degranulation, ROS and respiratory burst control and killing of bacteria and fungi, while confusables emphasise Fc-receptor regulation, formyl-peptide chemotaxis or monocyte identity signatures.

qualifier: osmosensory responses with sodium and potassium transport
name: Osmosensory responses and sodium/potassium transport regulation
rationale: Members combine hypo/hyperosmotic and osmosensory responses with regulation of Na+, K+ and transepithelial Cl- transport, distinguishing them from cation-chloride cotransporter disease, salt-stress and aldosterone neighbours.

qualifier: GABA and glycine synthesis, degradation and transport
name: GABA and glycine inhibitory neurotransmitter metabolism and transport
rationale: Members concern GABA synthesis, degradation, secretion and reuptake plus glycinergic transmission and related SLC transport, separating the theme from glutamate/aspartate transport and cholinergic neighbours.

qualifier: Cdc20/Cdh1-mediated degradation of mitotic substrates
name: APC/C regulation and degradation of mitotic substrates
rationale: All members concern APC/C activation, phosphorylation or inhibition and APC/C:Cdc20/Cdh1 destruction of cyclins, securin, Nek2A and Cdc20, unlike neighbours on Cdc20-to-Cdh1 switching, Emi1 or broader metaphase-anaphase events.

qualifier: primordial germ cells and early embryonic lineages
name: Primordial germ cell and early embryonic lineage specification
rationale: Members concern PGC specification, migration and germline stem cell maintenance alongside inner cell mass/trophectoderm differentiation, distinguishing the theme from gonadal somatic, oocyte maturation and decidualization neighbours.

qualifier: lactose synthesis and dietary disaccharide digestion
name: Galactose and lactose metabolism and dietary disaccharide digestion
rationale: Members cover the Leloir pathway and its GAL enzyme defects, galactose transport, lactose synthesis and intestinal disaccharide digestion, unlike neighbours on fructose, pentose phosphate or hexose transport.

qualifier: extracellular matrix and TGF-beta/EMT programme
name: Mesenchymal extracellular matrix and TGF-beta stromal program
rationale: Members describe fibroblast-like mechanoresponsive, EMT, collagen/TGF-beta and ECM signatures with focal adhesion assembly, whereas confusables emphasise fibronectin matrix, fibroblast migration/proliferation or stress fibers.

qualifier: negative feedback on steroid hormone secretion and signalling
name: Glucocorticoid response and negative feedback on steroid secretion
rationale: Members concern cellular responses to cortisol/dexamethasone and dampening of glucocorticoid signalling and steroid hormone secretion, unlike neighbours that drive ACTH/glucocorticoid secretion or circadian metabolic control.

qualifier: CFTR-dependent exocrine secretion
name: CFTR-dependent epithelial anion and fluid secretion
rationale: Members centre on CFTR trafficking/defects, anion and transepithelial water transport and exocrine (saliva, pancreatic) secretion, separating the theme from apical-surface, TRP/acid-sensing and basolateral secretion neighbours.

qualifier: primary cilium intraflagellar transport and cargo targeting
name: Primary cilium assembly, intraflagellar transport and cargo targeting
rationale: Members concern ciliogenesis, IFT, BBSome/ARL13B cargo targeting, transition zone and basal body docking with centriole control, distinguishing the theme from photoreceptor, motile multiciliated and centrosome-positioning neighbours.

qualifier: single-strand annealing, MMEJ and presynaptic RAD51 loading
name: Double-strand break end resection and annealing-based repair
rationale: Members cover DSB end processing/resection and the resection-dependent SSA, alt-NHEJ/MMEJ and BRCA2-RAD51 presynaptic steps, unlike neighbours on DSB sensing, classical NHEJ or D-loop resolution.

qualifier: germinal centre and plasma cell stages
name: B cell germinal centre and plasma cell differentiation
rationale: Members are B, memory B and plasma cell signatures plus germinal centre, Tfh/ICOS and B cell proliferation/survival regulation, distinguishing the theme from BCR signalling, CD27 and B-1 cell neighbours.

qualifier: oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrin inputs
name: RAF-MAPK activation by oncogenic RAF, Rap1 and integrins
rationale: Members concern RAF/BRAF mutant and fusion signalling and MAPK activation downstream of RAS, Rap1 and integrin GRB2/p130Cas links, with Rap1 and integrin inputs absent from RAS/MRAS and ERK feedback neighbours.

qualifier: organelle membrane tethering and repair
name: Clathrin-mediated endocytosis and organelle membrane tethering
rationale: Members concern clathrin coat dynamics, synaptic vesicle endocytosis and membrane docking/tethering and repair (Miro GTPases, ER-mitochondria, autophagosomes, gap junction internalisation), which the presynaptic/postsynaptic and vesicle-coating confusables lack.

qualifier: lamina disassembly and reformation onset
name: Mitotic nuclear lamina disassembly and envelope reformation initiation
rationale: Members concern nuclear membrane breakdown, lamina depolymerization and the start of NE reformation, unlike neighbours on ESCRT-III sealing, cytokinesis or nuclear pore complex dynamics.

qualifier: promotion of LTP and LTD with spine maturation
name: Promotion of LTP, LTD and dendritic spine maturation
rationale: Members concern positive regulation of long-term potentiation and depression, synapse and spine maturation, postsynaptic calcium and short-term memory, unlike neighbours on spine maintenance/reelin, synaptic translation or CREB-driven long-term memory.

qualifier: core circadian clock loop and MECP2
name: Core circadian clock loop and MECP2 neuronal transcription
rationale: Members combine the BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER feedback loop and its entrainment with MECP2 regulation and loss-of-function and activity-dependent CREB/NPAS4/HDAC transcription; each confusable has only one of these two arms.

qualifier: collagen/TGF-beta stromal genes and focal adhesion assembly
name: Collagen-TGF-beta stromal signaling and focal adhesion assembly
rationale: The three members share stromal matrix-adhesion signalling (collagen/TGF-beta module, plasma-membrane signal transduction, focal adhesion assembly), while confusables centre on integrin, fibronectin, stress fiber or MET signalling.
